steps.t: Use a retainer for steady monthly work.
steps.d: Repeating work gets a monthly scope, so your client pays a regular fee and you buy a regular delivery.

steps.t: Use a project for a defined build.
steps.d: A fixed scope with an end date suits a site or an app, and any change is quoted before it starts.

steps.t: Use a dedicated team for a steady queue.
steps.d: Named people work to your queue, and seats are added or paused as your workload changes.

steps.t: Compare the three before you quote.
steps.d: Best fit, scope and how changes work, side by side, so your quote matches how your client likes to buy.
